title: Heavy Rain on a Tin Roof for Sleeping - Cabin Attic, No Thunder, No Music | 8 Hours
description:
8 hours of heavy rain drumming on a tin roof, heard from a cabin attic bedroom. Bright, ringing drops on metal over a steady downpour. No thunder, no music, no talking.
The rain never loops, with a gentle fade in and a slow fade out at the end. Made for deep sleep, reading and study.
